Conference & Research Moments

ISMS Marketing Science Conference

Presenting our research on "Dynamics of Online WOM and Performance" at the ISMS Conference in July 2025. The nervous energy before the presentation, the engaging Q&A session, and the valuable feedback from fellow researchers made this conference unforgettable.

KOICA Cultural Exchange Program

As a teaching assistant, I had the wonderful opportunity to take international friends to experience traditional Korean Taekwondo. Sharing Korean culture with people from different countries and seeing their excitement was incredibly rewarding.

Research Life

Late Night Coding at KAIST

Working on the PlaceSim project until 3AM in the lab. There's something magical about debugging code when the campus is quiet and you can finally think clearly. This particular night, I had a breakthrough in the LLM behavior simulation algorithm that became the core of our CIKM paper.

First Day at Carnegie Mellon

The moment I walked into the Gates Building for the AI Intensive Program. Pittsburgh's winter was harsh, but the warmth of the AI community here made everything worth it. This photo was taken right before my first seminar presentation.
